content: सौख(प्र)सुप्तिकः [सुखसुप्तिं सुखेन शयनं पृच्छति ठञ्] .²1 One who asks another person whether he has slept well. .²2 A bard whose duty it is to waken a king or any other great personage with song and music; भ्रमरा … गुञ्जन्तः प्रतिकमलं प्रबभुः सौखप्रसुप्तिका इव ते <ls>Chola-Champū. p. 29, verse 67</ls>.
